info.title: Roltek Observability API
info.description: Monitors, status pages, alerts, SLOs, incidents and monitoring-as-code. The configuration document is roltek-observability-1. Versioning: by contract; see the module README.

post.summary: Create a monitor (a heartbeat token is returned once)

get.summary: One monitor (secrets and header values are never returned)
The JPEG a browser check took at the step that failed (its own permission)

post.summary: Pause, resume, delete or put in maintenance many monitors
Import monitors from CSV, YAML or JSON (dry run by default)

get.summary: One component with its uptime windows
The uptime report of the components a status page shows, over a period, as JSON, CSV or PDF (planned maintenance left out as the page leaves it out)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First UTC day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Default: the length of the default period before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last UTC day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Default: today. A period covers at most 92 days and starts at most 366 days back.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json (default), csv or pdf. csv and pdf are attachments.

parameters.name: objective
parameters.description: An uptime target, in percent (above 50, below 100), to judge every row against.

Confirm a subscription (a Slack or Teams subscriber only gets a confirmation button here: a link preview must not confirm)

get.summary: List ingest integrations (keys are never returned)

Where would an alert with these labels go?
Start a silence template (creates a normal silence; a console session, or an api key with observability_ops:silence)
Import OpenSLO v1 documents (dry run by default)

get.summary: The burn-rate and error-budget series of an SLO over its window (for the burn chart), with the current burn of every alert tier

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: The most points the series may have (2 to 200, default 120). Each point says its resolution (day, hour or merged) and its source (rollup or raw); a point with no events has a null burn, never 0.

get.summary: The uptime report of an availability SLO over a period, as JSON, CSV or PDF (planned maintenance left out as the status page leaves it out)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First UTC day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Default: the length of the default period before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last UTC day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Default: today. A period covers at most 92 days and starts at most 366 days back.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json (default), csv or pdf. csv and pdf are attachments.

post.summary: What would this document change? (writes nothing)
Hand a code-managed resource to the console

sessionCookie.name: session
sessionCookie.description: A console session. Every call needs the permission listed in x-permissions.

bearerApiKey.description: An api_key of the workspace. Only two groups of endpoints accept one: the configuration endpoints, with the scope observability_config:read (read, plan, export) or observability_config:write (apply, detach); and four operational actions (acknowledge an alert, declare an incident, start a silence template, add an incident note), each with its own exact scope observability_ops:ack, :incident, :silence or :note, which no other scope (admin included) grants.
